title: Manual DNA Extraction Protocol for Campylobacter Detection in Canine and Bovine Feces
author: Sara D. Lawhon
materials: QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Isolation Kit

This protocol uses VetMAX Xeno Internal Positive Control ND Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A29762/A29764 as a control for PCR inhibition. Note: This reagent can either be added at step 15 to serve as a DNA extraction control or after DNA extraction is complete to serve as the PCR inhibition control. If the laboratory has a system in place for DNA extraction and PCR inhibition, that method can be substituted in this protocol.

Combine reagents except for the DNA template in a 1.5ml or 2ml microcentrifuge tube and mix well.

Extract DNA from the feces using the QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Isolation Kit Qiagen Catalog #51804-50 following the manufacturer's protocol (outlined below). Tip: If you are following the manufacturer’s printed protocol, whenever the text says “vortex briefly” vortex for at least 5-10 seconds.

The probe is labeled with FAM with Black Hole Quencher 1 (BHQ1) so detection parameters appropriate for FAM or SYBR should be used.The developing laboratory uses Applied Biosystems™ VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA (ThermoFisher Scientific A29762 or A29764) and the VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control - VIC™ Assay (ThermoFisher Scientific A29765 or A29767) to monitor for PCR inhibition. Threshold is set at 0.2.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Preparation
steps.instruction: Store fecal samples at 4-8 °C and process within 72 hours of receipt.

steps.title: Prepare Feces-PBS Slurry
steps.instruction: Create a fecal slurry using PBS.

substeps.instruction: Add 32 mL 1X PBS (Life Technologies Catalog #10010-023) to 8 g of stool in 50 mL conical tubes.
Allow samples to sit for 2 minutes.
Vortex samples for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare Solution CD3
steps.instruction: Ensure Solution CD3 is fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Check for precipitate in Solution CD3; if present, heat to 60 °C in a water bath until dissolved.

steps.title: Initial Pellet Concentration
steps.instruction: Concentrate the feces-PBS slurry in a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of feces-PBS slurry to a microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Carefully remove and discard 800 µL of the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Bead Beating and Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and perform mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µL Solution CD1 (Qiagen) and 4 µL VetMAX Xeno Internal Positive Control (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A29762/A29764) to the pellet and resuspend.
Transfer the resuspended pellet to a manufacturer's bead tube.
Secure bead tubes horizontally on a Vortex Adapter (Qiagen (MoBio) 13000-V1-24) or secure to a flat-bed vortex pad with tape.
Vortex at maximum speed for 10 minutes (add an additional 5 minutes if vortexing more than 12 tubes).
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Protein and Contaminant Removal
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to purify the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 500-600 µL of the supernatant to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 µL of CD2 and vortex for 5 seconds.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 700 µL of supernatant (expect 500-600 µL) to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 600 µL of Solution CD3 and vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: DNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to the spin column and wash the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µL of lysate onto an MB Spin Column and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and repeat the loading process until all supernatant is on the column.
Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL of Solution EA, centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Place the column back into the same 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL of Solution C5, centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Place the column in a clean 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 mL elution tube.
Add 60 µL of Solution C6 to the center of the filter membrane.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the MB Spin Column.

steps.title: DNA Storage
steps.instruction: Store the isolated DNA based on the intended PCR timeline.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4 °C if PCR will be performed within 1-5 days.
Store at -20 °C if PCR will be performed after 5 days.

steps.title: PCR Setup and Execution
steps.instruction: Prepare and run the PCR reactions.

substeps.instruction: Calculate reagent quantities based on the number of reactions, including a positive control (C. jejuni ATCC 33291, 33292, or 33560), a negative control (E. coli ATCC 25922), and a 'No Template' negative control.
Aliquot 18 µL of master mix into each PCR tube or reaction well.
Add samples, positive/negative controls, and PCR inhibition controls (VetMAX Xeno Internal Positive Control ND Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A29762/A29764).
Place samples in the thermocycler and perform the run.

steps.title: Result Analysis
steps.instruction: Interpret the PCR results based on Ct values.

substeps.instruction: Analyze results and report with a Ct value.
Interpret samples with a Ct value of 40 or less as positive.
Interpret samples with a Ct value >40 or an undetermined Ct value as negative.
